definitions.gameplay.board_dice: The player acts on a board of tiles or dice during a run (rolling, moving a token, resolving tile effects). A board shown only as a choice of where to go next is not board_dice.
definitions.map_world.world_map: An overview of places, chapters or boards the player chooses between, outside of active play. Our 'maps' screen (three board tiles side by side) belongs here, not in board_dice.
definitions.gameplay.travel_exploration: The hero or party moves through a level, corridor or overworld during a run, without an active fight.
definitions.gameplay.board: Any board-game style play surface other than dice (card board, grid, tiles) during active play.
definitions.metagame.level_progression: Chapter, level or tier progress outside of play (level lists, progress tracks, star counts).
definitions.metagame.game_pass: A season or game pass reward track. Use events_rewards.battle_pass only when the screen is framed as a limited-time event.
definitions.metagame.evolution_upgrade: Upgrading, evolving, merging or ascending a hero, pet or item, outside of play.
definitions.metagame.player_profile: The player's own profile, account level, stats overview or avatar page.
definitions.metagame.inventory: Bag, item or equipment inventory lists (not a single item detail in gear).
definitions.title_image: The game's title: usually the IN-GAME TITLE SCREEN shown when the game opens (logo over the game's own art): composition single_full_capture with one capture of type title_image, subtype title_screen. Full-screen title art with the logo is composition pure_art (full-screen art), subtype logo_with_art or logo_only; it may still be the game's own title screen, so never call it 'not from the game'.
definitions.feature_image: PREFERRED for full-screen promotional art or a callout that highlights a feature (a character, a reward, a mode, a rating, a collaboration). If the logo is the main subject, use title_image; if it looks like a loading or splash screen, use loading_screen.
definitions.key_art: Only for non-gameplay art that is neither a title image nor a feature image.
definitions.promo: Only when promotional content sits on or beside a screenshot area; when the whole image is art, use feature_image.
definitions.loading_screen: A loading, splash or tips screen: full-screen art, often with the logo, a progress bar, a tip or a studio splash. Such screens are shown in the game; describe what is visible and never claim the image is not from the game.

band.size: height as a percent of the image
